name: PhishScore.ai
description: Community-driven threat intelligence platform for phishing and scam detection. Provides AI-powered risk scoring for emails, text messages, phone numbers, and links, plus a live feed of community-reported scam intelligence.

resources.name: Threat Glossary
resources.description: Definitions, red flags, and structured data (FAQPage/Article JSON-LD) for major scam categories.

resources.name: Sitemap
resources.description: XML sitemap of all public pages.

endpoints.name: Quick Scan
endpoints.description: Submit a suspicious email, text message, phone number, or link and receive an AI-generated risk score, scam category, and red-flag breakdown.

schema.input: string — the email, message, phone number, or URL to analyze

schema.flags: array — red flags identified in the input

endpoints.name: Recent Quick Scans
endpoints.description: Read-only feed of recent community quick-scan results.

endpoints.name: Threat Trends
endpoints.description: Aggregated trend data on top targeted sectors and threat levels.
